text:
anna: Starting a thread for the relnotes draft covering the JS SDK function-calling rename, a small migration page, and a short known-issue blurb. sending rough outline.
kevin: ping me on JS snippets. what's the rename?
jamie: breaking: js SDK v1.2 changes `functionHandler` -> `tool_call`. examples will fail for users who copy-paste. we should add a one-liner migration + 2 code examples (sync + streaming).
rachel: agree. also found 4 links in the go SDK docs that point to old anchors after the reorg. i'll include the fixed anchors in the relnotes and open a tiny patch.
anna: ok. i'll draft migrate-js.md with examples and link from relnotes. kevin 1 can you update docs/sdk/js/generation.md and docs/sdk/js/functions.md?
kevin: yep. i'll split into two PRs: #3701 (generation) and #3702 (functions). will also remove any hardcoded keys.
docs-bot: PR #3701 opened by kevin  draft JS generation updates.
jamie: sample migration snippet:
```js
// old
const { functionHandler } = require('redwood');
functionHandler({ name: 'summarize' }, input);

// new
const { tool_call } = require('redwood');
tool_call({ name: 'summarize' }, input);
```
use that in migrate-js.md.
kevin: also note: examples should call client.with({ sdkVersion: '1.2' }) comment. standardize to v1.2.
anna: good. Theo flagged a telemetry example in examples/chat.md with real-looking session IDs. theoretical privacy issue; scrubbed with placeholder tokens.
theo: yep, please replace with `process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY` pattern and remove any session ids.
rachel: timeline? marketing needs the relnotes by noon tomorrow for social copy.
anna: target: merge relnotes + migrate-js.md by 5pm PT today. kevin/jamie/rachel: review windows?
kevin: will get PRs up in 30m, request reviews immediately.
docs-bot: PR #3702 opened by kevin  JS function docs updated.
jamie: small known issue we should call out: function calling + streaming + large payloads can hit chunking edge-case causing truncated function args (internal ticket #501). workaround: set chunkSize to 64KB or use batch tools. i'll draft wording.
anna: good. also include rollback pointer: if customers need old behaviour, route to alias `legacy-functions-2026-01`. include curl example to switch alias.
kevin: curl snippet for alias switch:
```
curl -X POST \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/aliases/switch \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"alias":"legacy-functions-2026-01"}'
```
rachel: i'll patch the go doc anchors in a separate PR #3705. small fixes only.
docs-bot: PR #3705 opened by rachel  go anchor fixes.
anna: also add a short note: examples use SDK v1.2; update accordingly. append a checklist for engineers to verify snippets: 
- no hardcoded keys
- SDK version set to v1.2 in comments
- anchors updated
- migration page linked

kevin: will follow checklist in PR descriptions.
jamie: last call: make the relnotes entry concise and put the technical details in migrate-js.md. marketing likes a 2-3 bullet summary at top.
anna: agreed. i'll produce a polished relnotes draft and ping this channel with the link.
docs-bot: PR #3701 merged by kevin.
kevin: merged generation updates; moving to functions PR now.
anna: thanks team  aiming to merge everything by 17:00 PT. last_message_ts=1764013600
